events.verdict: Ayton (PHX) is firming up into a legal position while setting the pick on Korkmaz (PHI).
Korkmaz (PHI) makes contact to the body of Booker (PHX) during his upward shooting motion.
Jackson (PHX) commits a take foul on Simmons (PHI).
Booker (PHX) slightly extends his arm into Korkmaz's (PHI) body, but the contact does not dislodge Korkmaz from his legally obtained position.
Embiid (PHI) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Ayton (PHX) that affects his play at the basket.
Korkmaz (PHI) makes clean contact to the ball during the loose ball rebound.
During the pick, Bridges (PHX) reaches across and makes contact with Simmons (PHI) and affects his SQBR.
Ayton (PHX) establishes himself in a legal position in the path of Korkmaz (PHI) during the pick.
[Observable in enhanced review] Redick (PHI) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Bridges (PHX) makes contact to Redick's (PHI) body at the start of his drive to the basket.
Redick (PHI) briefly grasps Daniels' (PHX) arms, but does not affect his SQBR.
Redick (PHI) places his arm to the front of Booker (PHX) during the drive but the contact does not affect Booker's SQBR.
Booker (PHX) makes marginal contact with McConnell (PHI) during the screen. The reaction from McConnell is not consistent with the contact.
Booker (PHI) slightly extends his arm into McConnell (PHI), but does not dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Booker (PHX) makes marginal contact to Embiid's (PHI) body as he attempts to steal the ball.
Embiid (PHI) uses his arm to set the pick on Booker (PHX), but the contact does not dislodge Booker from his legally obtained position.
Simmons (PHI) is in the lane for at or about 3 seconds when the shot is imminent.
Jackson (PHX) commits a take foul on McConnell (PHI).
Redick (PHI) makes contact with Booker (PHX) after the pick, but does not affect his control of the ball.
Booker (PHX) makes marginal contact with McConnell's (PHI) body during the rebound.
Booker (PHX) commits a take foul on Simmons (PHI).
Daniels (PHX) enters the perimeter prior to the release of the free throw shot by Simmons (PHI).
Korkmaz (PHI) makes clean contact to the ball while in Ayton's (PHX) possession during the loose ball rebound.
Jackson (PHX) briefly grasps McConnell's (PHI) arm, but does not affect his FOM.
Jackson (PHX) makes clean contact to the ball during the inbounds.
Redick (PHI) grabs Jackson's (PHX) arm as he runs through the screen, affecting Jackson's ability to defend.
Jackson (PHX) commits a take foul on Redick (PHI).
RAR shows Booker (PHX) attempts to move into McConnell's (PHI) path during his shot attempt, but does not make contact.
Embiid (PHI) briefly clamps Ayton's (PHX) arm, but does not affect his FOM.
Redick (PHI) makes contact to the body of Booker (PHX), but does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Okobo (PHX) commits a take foul on Redick (PHI).
Simmons (PHI) makes a clean block during Bridges' (PHX) jump shot.
